summary: Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara formally applied Netanyahu's conflict-of-interest restrictions to the judicial-overhaul initiatives and told him to refrain from direct or indirect involvement because of a reasonable concern tied to his ongoing criminal trial.
notes: Canonical Sheet written first and independently corroborated by Associated Press and Jerusalem Post. Preserve that the opinion did not bar Justice Minister Yariv Levin or Constitution Committee chair Simcha Rothman from advancing the overhaul, and preserve Netanyahu/coalition objections. This is a formal attorney-general conflict-of-interest opinion, not a criminal finding or proof of personal motive.
